subject: [hw] T02 -> V41: fake hardware DMA/power semantics for n2vc_dma tests
body: tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c will provide: power refcounts per block (VENC_C1 implies VEN, VDEC_CORE implies VDEC_SOC), 12 windows, DMA first-fit pages in RW_CLAIM_VCODEC_PA..+0x5600000, zero-filled, handles stable, dma_rw plain copy. Accessor n2vc_hw_fake_dma_host(h,handle,&p,&bytes) gives the host mirror so your n2vc_dma_guest_map test can verify bytes without copying. Violation accessor counts register access to unpowered blocks. If you need dma_alloc to return physical addresses in a specific order or a fake `pa -> handle` lookup, post the exact need; I can add it in tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h.
